g.text: Local workbench: design deliberately across promoter references
Browser controls → separate Python runs → saved local comparison → opt-in off-target screen → order-ready duplexes
Human gene symbol or Ensembl gene ID
or your promoter DNA / one FASTA
Exact shared TSSs retain transcript IDs
Shared or pinned criteria per reference
AF22 local tracks · missing data explicit
Open each map, RNA cores and verdicts
Separate ranks · no pooled best score
Frozen runs, group links and screenings
Excel workbook: every candidate, run, rules
Order CSV of 21-mers · core CSV · JSON
Press a button; both scopes run at once
Candidate target DNA is sent to NCBI
Its own dated record; filters nothing
One job per run and scope, then polling
Guide and passenger named, with the reason
Sanity report travels in the row
Annotated start sites and researcher references do not establish promoter activity. Ratings count criteria, not activation probability. A screening finds sequence
similarity, which is not measured binding, and never removes a candidate.
Where data comes from and where it goes
Gene name or pasted DNA + settings
Start runs / groups, poll their status
Read saved results and download exports
Receive gene IDs or genomic regions
Scan promoter for candidate target sites
Build RNA pairs, evaluate each rule
Reject gate failures; rank by preferences
Cache-only mode fails if data is absent
Passing target DNA sequences go to NCBI
BLAST searches human RNA and genome
JSON, core CSV, order CSV with dTdT
GTEx is fetched separately for the gene overview; it does not change candidate ranks and is not part of the saved design snapshot.
The thesis validation CSVs are used by benchmark scripts, not as training data for the design engine.
Pasted DNA can be designed locally. Gene retrieval needs Ensembl or its cache; off-target screening needs NCBI.
Next: richer source evidence and bench-ready delivery
Planned work · green is done · the engine, workbench and local snapshots remain the foundation
Local data and arbitrary cell tracks
Partly done: the Excel workbook carries
the run, its rules and their sources
Still to write: a citable prose record
Wheel route needs no Git or repo access
Windows / macOS still unverified by a person
